stages.name: Aboard Crabby
stages.where: the Pacific, 40 miles out, 02:40
stages.hint: Tony Trihull is alongside and his gun is on Crabby. Put a harpoon into his transom — G.
stages.fail: Tony put a round through Crabby with you still on him.

stages.name: On Tony Trihull's transom
stages.where: under tow — 127 m of trimaran, 44 knots
stages.hint: The platform is coming up to starboard. Hook the barrier — G — and let Tony go.
stages.fail: Tony carried you straight past the platform and out into open ocean.

stages.name: Up the leg
stages.where: one hundred metres of wet steel
stages.hint: Steel magnets — M. Without them the wheels have nothing to hold.
stages.fail: Off the leg, and a hundred metres down into the water.

stages.name: Under the deck
stages.where: hanging off the underside on the magnets
stages.hint: Camera up — P — then shutter on P when the subject is framed. Three of them.
stages.fail: You hung there too long. A deck hand came under with a lamp.

stages.name: The platform
stages.where: seen — every lemon on the rig is awake
stages.hint: Oil behind you — 5 — then put a round through it — 2. Rockets on B.
stages.fail: They ran you down on the pipe deck.

stages.name: The link span
stages.where: sixty metres of truss and nothing underneath it
stages.hint: Limpet charge on the span — K — and be off it before it goes.
stages.fail: They came across the span behind you.

stages.name: The helipad
stages.where: the top deck, thirty metres above the sea
stages.hint: The platform ends here. Foils out — F — and go over the edge.
stages.fail: You went off with the wheels down. The car sank in eleven seconds.

stages.name: Hydrofoil
stages.where: open water, Tony astern and closing
stages.hint: He is shooting. Stay off his line — and keep the rockets lit.

stages.name: Play dead
stages.where: torpedo running, forty seconds out
stages.hint: Let the four tyres go — J. Give them a wreck to photograph.
stages.fail: The torpedo found a car instead of a decoy.

stages.name: Submerged
stages.where: and quietly away
stages.hint: Dive — J.

stages.name: The welcome party
stages.where: Tokyo, the night before the race
stages.hint: Down the carpet and out the back. Mind the press — a flashbulb in the mirrors and you are into the barrier.

stages.name: The washroom corridor
stages.where: two lemons and one American agent
stages.hint: Rod Torque Redline is cornered at the end. Get to him and take what he is holding — G.
stages.fail: They finished with Rod before you got there.

stages.name: The Tokyo street race
stages.where: night, wet asphalt, the Imperial Palace on your left
stages.hint: Race it. Finn is trying to reach you on the same channel Mater is using.

stages.name: Off the circuit
stages.where: through the barrier and into the city
stages.hint: Straight through the barrier — the lemons have seen the device.

stages.name: The back streets
stages.where: Grem and Acer, and no room at all
stages.hint: Smoke — 6 — and oil — 5. Put two of them out.
stages.fail: They boxed you in between two buildings.

stages.name: The Rainbow Bridge
stages.where: 1,875 m of suspension span over Tokyo Bay
stages.hint: Nowhere to hide up here. Shield up — 3 — and keep it lit.

stages.name: Haneda, the cargo apron
stages.where: Siddeley is at the far end with the ramp down
stages.hint: Down the taxiway to him. The ramp is at the end of it.

stages.name: Up the ramp, into Siddeley
stages.where: cargo netting, tie-downs, and two agents waiting
stages.hint: Straight up and in. Then hand over what Rod gave you — G.
stages.fail: Siddeley could not hold the slot any longer.

stages.name: Inside Big Bentley
stages.where: tied to the movement, and it is still running
stages.hint: The train is driving you back down. Keep the power on and climb out.
stages.fail: The escapement took you.

stages.name: The London circuit
stages.where: Westminster, the Embankment, Tower Bridge
stages.hint: Race it, and get to your own pit.

stages.name: The pit box
stages.where: and a bomb in your own air filter
stages.hint: McQueen is coming to say hello. Back away from him — R — then let him take the hook — G.
stages.fail: He got to you, and the timer did not care who was standing there.

stages.name: Out of range
stages.where: the detonator is line-of-sight and it has a limit
stages.hint: Rockets — B. Nine hundred metres and the detonator gives up.
stages.fail: He pressed it while you were still in range.

stages.name: The Mall
stages.where: five minutes on the clock, and one question to ask
stages.hint: Buckingham Palace. Whoever armed it is the only voice that can stop it.
stages.fail: The five minutes ran out on The Mall.

stages.name: The Furka Pass
stages.where: above Andermatt, July 1964
stages.hint: The Phantom III is ahead of you. Keep it in sight — the homer is on it. Tracker on 8.

stages.name: The white Mustang
stages.where: Tilly Masterson, and she is not shooting at you by accident
stages.hint: Get alongside her and put the slashers out — 4.
stages.fail: She got the shot she wanted.

stages.name: Auric Enterprises
stages.where: the works, after dark
stages.hint: Lamps off — the plates say Switzerland tonight. 1 to turn them over.

stages.name: The refinery yard
stages.where: the alarm is up and so are the floods
stages.hint: Oil — 5 — and short bursts on the guns — 2. Put two of them out.
stages.fail: They stopped the car in the yard.

stages.name: The wooded road
stages.where: one of them is on the back of the car
stages.hint: Smoke — 6 — for the ones behind, and the seat — 7 — for the one inside.
stages.fail: He got in and he stayed in.

stages.name: The headlights coming at you
stages.where: and there is no other car
stages.hint: Those are your own lamps. Stop before the wall.
stages.fail: Straight into the wall, exactly as it happened.

stages.name: Into Paris
stages.where: wet stone, plane trees, and the tower over your shoulder
stages.hint: Follow Finn. The river is at the end of this.

stages.name: The quay
stages.where: the Seine on your left and the market at the end of it
stages.hint: Along the water, then in through the arch.

stages.name: Marché aux Pièces
stages.where: a mile of second-hand parts under one iron roof
stages.hint: Find him. Tracker scope — 8. He is a rusted 2CV on three wheels.
stages.fail: He went out the far end and you never saw which way.

stages.name: He has seen you in a mirror
stages.where: PCS NO1R, going away from you at speed
stages.hint: Stay with him. He will put the stock down behind him.

stages.name: Cornered
stages.where: a dead end, and a photograph to show him
stages.hint: Stop, get the photograph up — P — and let him look at it.
stages.fail: Holley tasered him once too often and he shut up.

stages.name: The coast road
stages.where: Porto Corsa, and the marina a long way below you
stages.hint: Down into the town. The casino is the rock shaped like a Topolino.

stages.name: Ivan
stages.where: a Russian tow truck who works for Victor Hugo
stages.hint: Put him out — guns on 2, or run the slashers down his flank on 4.
stages.fail: Ivan reached the forecourt first, and there is only one of him.

stages.name: The casino forecourt
stages.where: valet parking, and a great many photographers
stages.hint: Victor Hugo goes in on your hook — G. Nobody stops a tow truck with a boss on it.
stages.fail: Victor Hugo found another truck.

stages.name: The casino floor
stages.where: and every lemon family in Europe is upstairs
stages.hint: Not on British plates. Revolve them — 1 — and go in as somebody else.
stages.fail: A doorman read BMT 216A and made a telephone call.

stages.name: The back room
stages.where: the bosses down one table, and their kingpin on a screen
stages.hint: Camera up — P — and get the table, the professor and the screen.
stages.fail: The meeting broke up and the screen went dark.

stages.name: The disguise comes off
stages.where: and the room knows exactly who you are
stages.hint: Two of them down and you are through the doors. Guns — 2.
stages.fail: They took the car apart on the casino floor.

stages.name: The Porto Corsa Grand Prix
stages.where: the port, the hill, the tunnel and Loews
stages.hint: Grem and Acer have the pulse camera on the Allinol runners. Race it.

stages.name: Out over the Casino Bridge
stages.where: and the whole town behind you
stages.hint: Smoke — 6 — and go.
stages.fail: They boxed you in on the hill above the port.

stages.hint: Stop, and put the photographs on the table — G.

stages.name: The Sassi
stages.where: Matera, and the walls are one car wide
stages.hint: Armoured glass will hold. Shield up — 3 — and keep moving.

stages.name: The steps
stages.where: a flight of limestone, and the only way down
stages.hint: Slow. The car will take it; the suspension will complain.

stages.name: Piazza San Giovanni Battista
stages.where: surrounded, and a Range Rover in your door
stages.hint: Full lock, hold the guns on — 2 — and turn the car all the way round.
stages.fail: They took the car apart in the square.

stages.name: Out of the square
stages.where: and something to leave behind you
stages.hint: Smoke — 6.
stages.fail: They stayed on you all the way out.

stages.name: Out of Matera
stages.where: the gorge on your right, and a train to catch
stages.hint: Go.
